## Summary

I investigated ticket T-6002 and found the root cause: when the docindex StatefulSet was scaled from 3 to 5 replicas, the `CLUSTER_SIZE` environment variable in the pod template wasn't updated. This caused docindex-3 to run as a standby node and fail all readiness probes, preventing docindex-4 from ever being created. The fix is to update the `CLUSTER_SIZE` environment variable to 5 to match the new replica count, which will allow the pods to become ready and complete the scale-up operation.
